title.narrative: ECO HUB PROJECT 2024: TRANSFORMING WASTE INTO ECONOMIC OPPORTUNITIES

description.narrative: The main objective of the project is Tofo Beach circular economy enhanced and community benefiting from a comprehensive waste management and recycle system. Among other activities ALMA will implement the following: 1) Promote Workshops, trainings, and awareness campaigns to educate and empower the local community to become agents of change for environmental clean-up; 2) Promote regular cleaning of public areas and roadways combing with plastic waste removal in Tofo, Tofinho, and Backdoor beaches; 3) Purchase and import a Plastic Sheet Press that will help establish a production line of recycled plastic furniture; 4) Production of Eco-Friendly Paving Stones, such as ecopavers, using recycled material to pave roads, paths and houses, 5) Development of New Recycled Handicraft Products; 7) Analysis of Plastic Waste in Tofo Beach for Source Identification and 8) Design and implement innovative projects in waste management and recycling to create new processes and products with potential to improve local people’s livelihoods.
